name: Wyze Lock Bolt v2 (US)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; Bluetooth for setup and some app features.

matter.note: Neither Wyze page mentions Matter; no CSA listing was checked.

google_home.note: Wyze's page says you can unlock with Google Assistant.

alexa.note: Wyze's page says you can unlock with Alexa.

home_assistant.note: No Home Assistant integration page checked for this lock.

hubRequired.note: Built-in Wi-Fi; no hub or gateway is mentioned.

localControl.note: Wyze doesn't say whether the lock works without its cloud.

lockFit.note: Replaces a single-cylinder deadbolt on wooden doors 1-3/8 to 2-11/64 in thick.

power.note: Batteries included; USB-C emergency power port.

summary: Wyze's Lock Bolt v2 (WLCKB2) is a Wi-Fi deadbolt that you can unlock with Alexa or Google Assistant, with no hub needed. It has a backlit glass keypad and takes eight AA batteries, with a USB-C port for emergency power. Wyze's pages don't mention Matter, Apple Home or SmartThings.
caveats: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only; Bluetooth is for setup and some app features.
Not for glass, sliding, mortise or multi-point doors.
Matter and Apple Home support are not confirmed.
